headline: GEL plunges 25% on an open price gap while TTCL jumps 33.3% over the past five days.
market_take: Today's coverage shows heightened volatility across construction, property and food stocks. Several property names (AWC, RML, CGD) posted double‑digit gains on strong volume spikes, whereas construction peers (GEL, PLE, SOLAR) suffered sharp declines. The food sector faced multiple price gaps and intraday swings, notably AQUA and XBIO down over 9% and 11% respectively. PF&REITs posted modest upside, led by SSPF, but also saw downside pressure in M‑PAT.

sector_notes.note: AQUA opened down 9.09% and later rose 10% intraday; XBIO opened down 11.11%; MADAME showed a 9.72% intraday rise; CFRESH recorded a volume spike 3.1σ above its 20‑day average.
AWC surged 11.94% with a 4.5σ volume spike and a 9.49% intraday move; RML rose 11.11% intraday; CGD up 10% intraday; PRIN experienced a -100% price gap and its AGM resolution was disapproved.

GEL dropped 25% on an open gap; PLE fell 22.22% intraday; SOLAR down 8.33% intraday; CNT down 6.19% intraday; TTCL posted a 33.3% gain over five days; STPI opened up 5.47% and has multiple capital‑change filings.
SSPF rose 6.87% intraday; M‑PAT fell 6.47% intraday with a 1.4× volume; KTBSTMR showed a 3.6σ volume spike; QHBREIT announced a paid‑up capital decrease.
